title: SIEM Alert: Unauthorized Vendor Session on Pump Network

fields.rule: Unauthorized Vendor Session with Network Scanning and Configuration Change
fields.ruleDescription: A vendor session broker (ORRMC-VSB01) authenticated from IP 203.0.113.77 using account pumplink-support, which had a password reset at 13:46. During the session (13:48–13:58), the account performed port scans across three device subnets and modified the drug library on ORRMC-PUMP01.
tactics: T1041 Exfiltration Over Command and Control Channel

details.value: Drug library updated to 4.2.2 on ORRMC-PUMP01
Yes - 41 pumps updated, 4 telemetry patients dropped
Telemetry display loss, pump library update, scanning detected

fields.rawEvent: 2026-03-12T13:48:22-05:00 ORRMC-VSB01 VENDOR-ACCESS 100002: Session established from 203.0.113.77 for user pumplink-support via password reset. 2026-03-12T13:55:11-05:00 ORRMC-VSB01 VENDOR-ACCESS 100005: Configuration change applied on ORRMC-PUMP01 (drug library 4.2.2). 2026-03-12T13:55:47-05:00 ORRMC-VSB01 VENDOR-ACCESS 100008: Port scan initiated on 10.40.10.0/24, 10.40.30.0/24, 10.40.40.0/24. 2026-03-12T13:58:44-05:00 ORRMC-VSB01 VENDOR-ACCESS 100001: Session closed normally.

instructorNote: This inject confirms the attacker's presence on the device network and establishes a chain of evidence for the ISO to act on. Watch for the ISO to block the vendor account and source IP, and to escalate to the AOC for HCC Level 2 activation.
